title: Hydraulic 3-Roll Plate Rollers, 2 to 10 ft | NovoTech
meta_description: Initial-pinch and double-pinch hydraulic 3-roll plate rollers from 2.1 to 10.2 ft, plate up to 3-1/2″, with drop-end and digital readouts. CSA panels, parts in Mississauga, ON.
intro: Three-roll plate rolling machines with hydraulic roll positioning and motor-driven rolls: the operator pinches the sheet, pre-bends the leading edge, rolls the cylinder and opens the hydraulic drop-end to take it off. İşitan's initial-pinch MRM-H covers 2.1 ft to 10 ft and plate to 1/2″ with two digital readouts and cone bending as standard, and the compact 3R HMD puts hydraulic back-roll positioning with a joystick on a cast-iron frame; Şahinler's double-pinch 3R HS rolls plate to 1-1/8″ with extended shafts for profile rolls, and the translating-type 3R UHS takes plate to 3-1/2″ on 10.2 ft. Hydraulic plate rollers with CSA-approved panels, sold and supported from Mississauga, ON.

faq.q: How does an initial-pinch 3-roll plate roller work?
faq.a: The sheet is clamped (pinched) between the top and bottom roll, the back roll is raised to pre-bend the leading edge, the sheet is fed through and rolled to the radius set by the back roll, and the drop-end is opened to remove the cylinder. The trailing edge is pre-bent by turning the sheet around — the one extra step compared with a 4-roll machine.

faq.q: MRM-H or MRM-S — hydraulic or mechanical?
faq.a: Both are initial-pinch rolls with the same roll sizes. The MRM-H moves its back and bottom rolls hydraulically and opens the drop-end hydraulically, which is faster, takes thicker plate at the same roll diameter and suits daily production; the MRM-S moves the back roll with a motor and opens the drop-end by hand at a lower price.

faq.q: What thickness can the MRM-H roll?
faq.a: From 20 ga sheet on the 1270x80 up to 1/2″ plate on the 250 mm roll models — see the capacity tables, which give the thickness at 1.5× and at 5× the top roll diameter. Capacities are for mild steel; stainless and high-strength plate need the next roll size up.

faq.q: What voltage do İşitan plate rollers run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V as standard with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request, and 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor. Manual slip rolls have no electrics.
